title: Rational invariants of three frames in the split Albert algebra: a Lean formalization
abstract: Let J be the split Albert algebra over a field k of characteristic zero, the 27-dimensional Jordan algebra of 3 by 3 Hermitian matrices over the split octonions, with trace tr. A frame is an ordered triple of trace-one idempotents summing to 1. Three frames E, F, K carry 54 natural invariants under the group G of all unital k-linear bijections of J preserving its Jordan product: the pair traces tr(eᵢ∘fⱼ), tr(fⱼ∘kₗ), tr(kₗ∘eᵢ) and the triple traces tr(eᵢ∘(fⱼ∘kₗ)). This Lean 4 development proves that these traces do not generate all rational invariants of three frames, and that adjoining one additional invariant suffices: the field of G-invariant rational functions on the variety of frame triples is a quadratic extension H(d) of the field H generated by the 54 traces, where d = tr(W∘(W∘W)), W = x∘(y∘z) − y∘(x∘z), x = e₂ − e₀, y = f₂ − f₀, z = k₂ − k₀. The development also proves that the variety of frame triples is irreducible, that the coordinate algebra used is the standard split Albert algebra, that d is not in H, and that every invariant is uniquely a + b·d with a, b in H. The ambiguity occurs over ℚ: two explicit frame triples have identical 54 traces and d = −2591357/62208 and −1782559/62208, and no ℚ-linear automorphism of J combined with any of the 1,296 relabellings of frames and idempotents carries one to the other. The proved endpoints use only the permitted axiom dependencies propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice; a Python script rechecks the example in exact arithmetic.
